wikipedia.title: Titan Company
wikipedia.extract: Titan Company Limited is an Indian fashion accessories company that mainly manufactures items such as jewellery, watches and eyewear. Part of the Tata Group and started as a joint venture with TIDCO, the company has its corporate headquarters in Electronic City, Bangalore, and registered office in Hosur, Tamil Nadu.

official_website.title: Titan Company Ltd.
official_website.description: Welcome to Titan's home on the internet. We've grown into India's leading lifestyle company by creating elevating experiences for the people we touch.
